question: With which of the following sports is Fouaad Mirza associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __equestrian.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Fouaad Mirza is an Indian equestrian.
 
• He is from Bangalore.
 
• An equestrian is someone who is involved with horses.
 
• Fouaad Mirza is an Indian equestrian who won silver medals in both individual eventing and team eventing at the 2018 Asian Games.
 
• Fouaad Mirza was India's third-ever entry in equestrian at the Tokyo Olympics 2020, after Indrajit Lamba's appearance in 1996 and Imtiaz Anees in 2000.
